integrity: The proof reconstructs the Schwarzian from the Schwarz-parameter representation, uses Schwarz--Pick and two exact nonnegative-defect decompositions, classifies equality through Schwarz rigidity, and matches the negative boundary by a disk automorphism whose values and derivative align all terms. A standalone symbolic checker was executed for the exact algebra and a rational counterexample. The extension conclusion uses Ahlfors--Weill as a sufficient criterion only.
scientific_limitations: The exact claim concerns the unit hyperbolic Schwarzian norm threshold for real quadratic targets in their entire target-univalence range. It does not give the exact norm below the phase boundary, nor assert an optimal quasiconformal extension dilatation. Negative parameters are not necessarily Ma--Minda convex targets; no convexity conclusion is made there.
title: Sharp Schwarzian phase boundary for quadratic subordination targets
